intro: Somalia is called a 'nation of poets', where verse is part of daily life.

chapters.title: Poetry
text: Poetry is part of everyday life and politics. Somali was only written in Latin letters from 1972.

chapters.title: Food
text: Canjeero (a pancake-like bread), rice with spiced meat, and camel milk are common.
